name.ja: ピカちんキット０２ ふりかけメーカー

description.ja: • なんでもふりかけにできちゃう優れモノ！
description.en: • A great product that can be used as furikake for anything!

description.ja: • テレビ番組「ポチっと発明 ピカちんキット」に登場するふりかけメーカーが商品化！
description.en: • The furikake maker that appears on the TV program "Pochitto Invention Pikachin Kit" has been commercialized!

description.ja: • ふりかけメーカーとは、お菓子をくだいてオリジナルのふりかけが作れちゃう発明品！
description.en: • The furikake maker is an invention that allows you to make your own original furikake by breaking up sweets!

description.ja: • まだ誰も見つけていない新しいレシピを開発しよう！
description.en: • Let's develop a new recipe that no one has found yet!

description.ja: • ピカちん大百科に綴じられるピカちんシートも付いてくるぞ！
description.en: • It also comes with a Pikachin sheet that can be bound into the Pikachin Encyclopedia!
